prisoner.name: Raymundo Manalo
prisoner.description: Raymundo Manalo appears in the US Army prisoner register for Balayan, Batangas, during the Philippine-American War. The record describes this detainee as an insurgent tax collector and documents confinement followed by transfer to Manila in 1901. The subsequent release history remains unresolved.

cases.charges: US military detention as alleged insurgent tax collector; no criminal conviction established
cases.sentence: The US Army register records capture and detention at Balayan, followed by transfer to Manila on 1901-02-10. No release-to-freedom date or individual criminal sentence is recorded in the reviewed entries. The transfer is retained in this account, not entered as release or a new arrest.
